It uses **only the agent contract**: **Customer Simulation** posts to `POST /v1/agent/tickets` (202) and polls `GET /v1/agent/cases/{id}`; **Inventory** renders the `GET /v1/fixtures` catalogue; **ticket detail** reads `GET /v1/agent/cases/{id}` and its `.../timeline`, and continues `waiting_input`/`failed` cases via `POST .../continue`. The legacy `/v1/tickets` and `/v1/cases/*` routes and demo fault injection (host-only, `SWAPDESK_ENABLE_DEMO_FAULTS=1`) are not exposed in the console. Run the worker (`uv run python -m swapdesk.worker`) to advance the queue. **Reset Mock Data** (inventory page) restores the local demo state. Completion rate is computed from the queue and cost shows "Demo Mode".

177:   tickets: Ticket[];
178:   inventory: InventoryItem[];
179:   fixtures: FixturesOut | null;
180:   health: ApiHealth;
181:   apiError: string | null;
182:   caseStatus: Record<string, AgentStatusOut>;
183:   refreshHealth: () => Promise<boolean>;
184:   loadFixtures: () => Promise<FixturesOut | null>;
185:   /** POST /v1/agent/tickets — 202 accepted; progress streams via polling. */
186:   submitAgentTicket: (input: AgentTicketIn) => Promise<Ticket>;
187:   /** GET /v1/agent/cases/{id} — one status read; starts polling if active. */
188:   loadCase: (id: string) => Promise<AgentStatusOut | null>;
189:   getTimeline: (id: string) => Promise<TimelineEvent[]>;
190:   continueCase: (id: string, input: AgentContinueIn) => Promise<AgentContinueOut>;
191:   /* Local demo helpers (offline fallback). */
192:   simulateTicket: () => Ticket;
193:   submitCustomerTicket: (message: string) => Ticket;
194:   resetMockData: () => void;
195:   getTicket: (id: string) => Ticket | undefined;
196: };

200: export function SwapDeskProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
201:   const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<Ticket[]>(createInitialTickets);
202:   const [inventory, setInventory] = useState<InventoryItem[]>(createInitialInventory);
203:   const [fixtures, setFixtures] = useState<FixturesOut | null>(null);
204:   const [health, setHealth] = useState<ApiHealth>("unknown");
205:   const [apiError, setApiError] = useState<string | null>(null);
206:   const [caseStatus, setCaseStatus] = useState<Record<string, AgentStatusOut>>({});
207:   const seq = useRef(9045);
208:   const pollers = useRef(new Map<string, number>());
209: 
210:   /* Rehydrate cases created through the API after mount (avoids SSR drift). */
211:   useEffect(() => {
212:     const live = readLiveCases();
213:     if (live.length === 0) return;
214:     const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
215:       setTickets((prev) => [...live, ...prev.filter((ticket) => !ticket.live)]);
216:     }, 0);
217:     return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
218:   }, []);
219: 
220:   useEffect(() => {
221:     writeLiveCases(tickets);
222:   }, [tickets]);
223: 
224:   /* Stop every background poll when the provider unmounts. */
225:   useEffect(() => {
226:     const timers = pollers.current;
227:     return () => {
228:       timers.forEach((timer) => window.clearTimeout(timer));
229:       timers.clear();
230:     };
231:   }, []);
232: 
233:   const rememberTicket = useCallback((ticket: Ticket) => {
234:     setTickets((prev) => [ticket, ...prev.filter((existing) => existing.id !== ticket.id)]);
235:   }, []);
236: 
237:   const applyStatus = useCallback((id: string, status: AgentStatusOut) => {
238:     setCaseStatus((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: status }));
239:     const view = statusView(status);
240:     setTickets((prev) =>
241:       prev.map((ticket) =>
242:         ticket.id === id
243:           ? {
244:               ...ticket,
245:               status: view.status,
246:               statusLabel: view.statusLabel,
247:               actions: view.actions,
248:               outcome: status.outcome ?? undefined,
249:               reply: status.reply ?? undefined,
250:               exchangeId: status.exchange_id,
251:               executionStatus: status.execution_status,
252:               clarification: status.clarification,
253:               error: status.error,
254:               traceId: status.trace_id,
255:               requestsSpent: status.requests_spent,
256:               cleanup: status.cleanup,
257:               runId: status.current_run_id ?? ticket.runId,
258:             }
259:           : ticket,
260:       ),
261:     );
262:   }, []);
263: 
264:   /* Poll a case until it reaches a terminal state or needs input. The
265:    * worker (python -m swapdesk.worker) advances queued runs. */
266:   const watchCase = useCallback(
267:     (id: string) => {
268:       if (pollers.current.has(id)) return;
269:       const poll = async () => {
270:         try {
271:           const status = await apiGetAgentCase(id);
272:           applyStatus(id, status);
273:           if (isActiveExecution(status.execution_status)) {
274:             pollers.current.set(id, window.setTimeout(poll, POLL_MS));
275:           } else {
276:             pollers.current.delete(id);
277:           }
278:         } catch {
279:           pollers.current.delete(id);
280:         }
281:       };
282:       pollers.current.set(id, window.setTimeout(poll, 0));
283:     },
284:     [applyStatus],
285:   );
286: 
287:   const refreshHealth = useCallback(async () => {
288:     try {
289:       const result = await apiGetHealth();
290:       const online = result.ok === true;
291:       setHealth(online ? "online" : "offline");
292:       if (online) setApiError(null);
293:       return online;
294:     } catch (error) {
295:       setHealth("offline");
296:       setApiError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Health check failed");
297:       return false;
298:     }
299:   }, []);
300: 
301:   const loadFixtures = useCallback(async () => {
302:     try {
303:       const result = await apiGetFixtures();
304:       setFixtures(result);
305:       setApiError(null);
306:       return result;
307:     } catch (error) {
308:       setApiError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not load fixtures");
309:       return null;
310:     }
311:   }, []);
312: 
313:   useEffect(() => {
314:     const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
315:       void refreshHealth();
316:       void loadFixtures();
317:     }, 0);
318:     return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
319:   }, [refreshHealth, loadFixtures]);
320: 
321:   const submitAgentTicket = useCallback(
322:     async (input: AgentTicketIn) => {
323:       const accepted = await apiSubmitAgentTicket(input);
324:       const ticket: Ticket = {
325:         id: accepted.case_id,
326:         message: input.message,
327:         status: "processing",
328:         statusLabel: accepted.execution_status === "queued" ? "Queued" : "Agent Processing",
329:         actions: ["INTAKE", accepted.run_id.toUpperCase()],
330:         time: "Just now",
331:         sku: input.order_item_id ?? "—",
332:         live: true,
333:         executionStatus: accepted.execution_status,
334:         runId: accepted.run_id,
335:         duplicate: accepted.duplicate,
336:       };
337:       rememberTicket(ticket);
338:       setHealth("online");
339:       setApiError(null);
340:       watchCase(accepted.case_id);
341:       return ticket;
342:     },
343:     [rememberTicket, watchCase],
344:   );
345: 
346:   const loadCase = useCallback(
347:     async (id: string) => {
348:       try {
349:         const status = await apiGetAgentCase(id);
350:         applyStatus(id, status);
351:         if (isActiveExecution(status.execution_status)) watchCase(id);
352:         return status;
353:       } catch {
354:         return null;
355:       }
356:     },
357:     [applyStatus, watchCase],

362:       return await apiGetAgentCaseTimeline(id);
363:     } catch {

366:   }, []);

## Objective
- Wire the SwapDesk backend API into the Next.js frontend, one endpoint at a time with clean code, no commit/push. Latest directive: point the frontend at the deployed backend **`https://swapdesk-7yvl.onrender.com`**, restore the user's stashed changes, and continue the endpoint todos (agent-only routes + new reads).

## Important Details
- **Target API URL: `https://swapdesk-7yvl.onrender.com`** (deployed FastAPI backend). Use the Next same-origin rewrite proxy (`/v1/:path*` → target; override via `SWAPDESK_API_URL`) so the browser never makes a cross-origin call. `NEXT_PUBLIC_SWAPDESK_API_URL` switches to direct cross-origin calls (needs CORS).
- **User directives:** implement endpoints **one at a time**, write clean code, **do not commit/push**, and **unstash** the user's stashed changes.
- **`docs/API_CONTRACT.md` is normative for `/v1/agent/*`.** `POST /v1/agent/tickets` is now async: **202 accepted** (`case_id`, `run_id`, `execution_status`, `status_url`, `duplicate`) — must poll the status route.
- **Frontend MUST NOT use legacy routes:** `POST /v1/tickets`, `GET /v1/cases/{id}`, `GET /v1/cases/{id}/timeline`, `POST /v1/cases/{id}/continue`, `POST/DELETE /v1/demo/faults` (403 unless `SWAPDESK_ENABLE_DEMO_FAULTS=1`). `GET /v1/health` and `GET /v1/fixtures` are safe.
- Enums: `execution_status` = `queued | running | waiting_input | completed | failed`; `outcome` = `arranged | clarification | denial | escalation | null`. `clarification` parks in `waiting_input`, continued via the same agent path.
- **New endpoints from pasted OpenAPI (verified live):**
  - `GET /v1/ready` → `{ok, service, queued_depth, oldest_queued_age_s, last_terminal_at, note}`. Live: `{"ok":true,"service":"swapdesk","queued_depth":0,"oldest_queued_age_s":null,"last_terminal_at":null,"note":"queue state only: ..."}`.
  - `GET /v1/agent/cases` (query `execution`, `outcome`, `limit`, `cursor`) → `{items:[{case_id, message, order_id, order_item_id, size, qty, execution_status, outcome, current_run_id, runs, created_at, updated_at, reply}], next_cursor, total, summary:{execution_status:{}, outcome:{}}}`. Live: `{"items":[],"next_cursor":null,"total":0,"summary":{"execution_status":{},"outcome":{}}}`.
  - `GET /v1/inventory` (query `sku`, `size`, `limit`, `offset`) → `{items:[{sku, size, on_hand, held, available}], limit, offset, total, read_at}`. Live: total 14, e.g. `{"sku":"AIRFLOW-RUNNER","size":"40","on_hand":10,"held":0,"available":10}`.
- Backend models: `AgentTicketIn` (message≥1, order_id, order_item_id, size, qty, consent_size, case_id, idempotency_key, resume), `AgentStatusOut` (case_id, execution_status, outcome, reply, exchange_id, runs, current_run_id, clarification, cleanup, trace_id, error, requests_spent).
- Startup: `uv run uvicorn swapdesk.api:app --port 8000` + `uv run python -m swapdesk.worker`. Knobs: `SWAPDESK_WORKER_POLL_MS`=200, `SWAPDESK_AGENT_BUDGET`=12, `SWAPDESK_RUN_TIMEOUT_S`=300, `SWAPDESK_CORS_ORIGINS`=`http://localhost:3000,http://127.0.0.1:3000`.
- Frontend stack: Next.js 16.4.0 (App Router, Turbopack, `cacheComponents`+`partialPrefetching`), React 19, TS strict, alias `@/*` → `./src/*`, Tailwind v4. `@tanstack/react-query` dep unused.
- Strict ESLint rule `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect`; mount-time setState must be wrapped, e.g. `window.setTimeout(() => { ... }, 0)`. 3 pre-existing lint errors remain only in untouched files: `frontend/src/components/ui/carousel.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx`, `frontend/src/hook/use-mobile.tsx`.
- **Dynamic-route constraint:** `app/ticket/[id]/page.tsx` must keep the `<Suspense>` split (client hooks using URL data live behind Suspense so the static shell pre-renders) — per `frontend/README.md`.
- Only one `next dev` per project: a second instance exits with a lock notice ("You can access the existing server at http://localhost:3000"). Config changes (e.g. `next.config.ts`) require a dev-server restart.
- `frontend/package-lock.json` shows 144 churn deletions (`"libc":`/glibc); consider `git restore --staged frontend/package-lock.json`.
- `.entire/settings.local.json` created with `"commit_linking": "always"`; gitignored by `.entire/.gitignore`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Probed the live remote: `GET /v1/health`, `/v1/ready`, `/v1/agent/cases?limit=3`, `/v1/inventory?limit=3` all returned valid data (shapes above).
- **Step 1:** `frontend/next.config.ts` default target → `https://swapdesk-7yvl.onrender.com` (`SWAPDESK_API_URL` override retained); updated `frontend/src/lib/api.ts` header doc.
- **Step 2:** added `ReadyOut` type + `getReady()` in `api.ts`; store `ready` state + `refreshReady()` (called in mount effect); Mission Control readiness pill showing `Queue N` / `Queue clear` (title = `ready.note`).
- **Step 3:** added `AgentCaseListItem`, `AgentCaseListOut`, `AgentCaseListQuery`, `listAgentCases()` in `api.ts`; store `refreshCases()` (hydrates tickets from the list, restarts `watchCase` for active cases) + `ticketFromCase()` + `relativeTime()` + `statusView()` refactored to accept a narrow `CaseViewInput`.
- **Step 4:** added `InventoryRow`, `InventoryOut`, `InventoryQuery`, `getInventory()` in `api.ts`; store `liveStock` state + `loadInventory()`; Inventory page "Live stock" table (GET /v1/inventory) + refresh calls both `loadFixtures()`/`loadInventory()`.
- `npm run build` passed after each step; ESLint clean on changed files (only the 3 pre-existing errors).
- Earlier: `stash@{0}` ("second stach") popped; a README.md conflict resolved by keeping the stashed agent-contract paragraph (then `git add README.md` + `git stash drop`).

### Active
- **User re-stashed my in-progress work.** Working tree is clean at HEAD **`26cfedc Connect frontend to agent backend contract`**; `stash@{0}: new stash` exists with base **`dbee0b3`**. `git diff HEAD stash@{0} --stat` = 21 files, 1638 insertions/1142 deletions — includes my latest work (remote URL, `getReady`/`listAgentCases`/`getInventory`) **and divergent changes my work did not make** (deletes `frontend/AGENTS.md`, `frontend/app/inbox/inbox-list.tsx`, `frontend/src/lib/use-case.ts`; edits `frontend/src/components/ui/carousel.tsx`, `sidebar.tsx`, `frontend/src/hook/use-mobile.tsx`).
- HEAD's `frontend/next.config.ts` has **no** rewrite; HEAD's `frontend/src/lib/api.ts` has a `getInventory(params?: ...)` but **not** `listAgentCases`/`getReady`. So the stash holds the newer work that must be restored to continue.
- Deciding whether stash content is needed in full, and whether to `git stash apply` (safer than `pop`) then resolve conflicts.

### Blocked
- Verification of the remote proxy is pending: the throwaway dev server on `:3100` exited due to the lock held by the existing dev server on `:3000`. The `:3000` dev server (PID `26248`) was killed and a restart was attempted but the tool call was aborted; running-process state is now unclear (local uvicorn on `:8000` was also being killed).
- Risk: applying `stash@{0}` on HEAD `26cfedc` (base `dbee0b3`) may conflict; the stash touches files unrelated to my work.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `stash@{0}: new stash` (`git stash show -p` / `git diff HEAD stash@{0}`) and restore it (`git stash apply`, not `pop`) — resolve conflicts so `next.config.ts` targets the remote and `api.ts`/store/pages contain `getReady`, `listAgentCases`, `getInventory`.
2. Confirm no stale dev servers, start a single `npm run dev` on `:3000`, and verify `/v1/health`, `/v1/ready`, `/v1/agent/cases`, `/v1/inventory` proxy to the remote (e.g. inventory `total=14`, `AIRFLOW-RUNNER` rows).
3. Re-run `npm run build` + `npm run lint`, then report. Do not commit/push.

## Relevant Files
- `docs/API_CONTRACT.md`: normative agent-path contract and change notice.
- `frontend/next.config.ts`: `/v1/:path*` rewrite proxy; default now `https://swapdesk-7yvl.onrender.com`; HEAD version has NO rewrite — must be restored from stash.
- `frontend/src/lib/api.ts`: typed client (agent-only + `getHealth`/`getReady`/`getFixtures`/`getInventory`/`submitAgentTicket`/`getAgentCase`/`listAgentCases`/`getAgentCaseTimeline`/`continueAgentCase`).
- `frontend/src/store/swapdesk.tsx`: API-backed store (poll `watchCase`, `caseStatus` map, `ready`, `refreshCases`, `liveStock`, `loadInventory`, offline mock fallback + localStorage).
- `frontend/app/mission-control.tsx`: readiness pill (`Queue N`/`Queue clear`) + ticket queue.
- `frontend/app/inventory/page.tsx`: "Live stock" table (GET /v1/inventory) + fixtures catalogue/policy.
- `frontend/app/ticket/[id]/page.tsx`: agent status/timeline/continue with polling; keep `<Suspense>` split.

This is React's Float/"outside the main document" check. It triggers when a `<script>` is rendered outside `<head>` or `<body>` — i.e., as a direct child of `<html>` between `<html>` and `<body>`. The `<Script>` with `beforeInteractive` in dev likely renders the actual `<script>` immediately (not hoisted), and because it was placed as a direct child of `<html>` (outside both head and body), React complained.

By moving it inside `<body>`, it's now "somewhere in the <body>" which the error message explicitly allows: "move it into the root <head> tag or somewhere in the <body>." So the fix is correct.
